entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: An ancient Thran artificer who designed powerstones; he possessed an untriggered planeswalker spark.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: One of the Untouchables who stabbed Glacian with a powerstone.

entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: Glacian's wife, with influence in the council.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Healer recalled from exile, who fell in love with Rebbec and marginalized Glacian.

entities.name: Dyfed
entities.description: Used a powerstone to create a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Later found the powerstone with Mishra and Tocasia.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother of Urza who found the stone.

entities.name: Caves of the Damned
entities.description: Place to which Yawgmoth banished Glacian.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: Half of the stone that made creatures stronger.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: Half of the stone that made creatures weaker.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War resulting from the brothers' desire for the other half of the stone.

events.summary: Gix stabs Glacian with a powerstone, giving him phthisis; Rebbec recalls Yawgmoth from exile to heal him.
events.quote: Rebbec , used her influence in the council to recall the healer Yawgmoth from his exile

events.summary: Yawgmoth's serum fails on Glacian, who grows paranoid and develops multiple personality disorder.
events.quote: it had no effect on Glacian

events.summary: Yawgmoth, in love with Rebbec, banishes Glacian to the Caves of the Damned and secretly replaces the stone sliver with the two halves of Dyfed's powerstone; the radiation kills Glacian.
events.quote: The radiation of these stones killed him, but his essence was trapped inside them

events.summary: Clear-minded, Glacian's essence convinces Rebbec to unify the halves and close the portal to Phyrexia.
events.quote: he convinced Rebbec to unify the halves and use them to close the portal to Phyrexia forever

relations.quote: After being stabbed with a powerstone by Gix
Yawgmoth had fallen in love with Rebbec

relations.note: radiation of the replaced stones killed him
